effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent's hand has 6 or more cards, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, by trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, you may play or use 1 [DATA SQUAD] trait card with a play or use cost of 5 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits or the [DATA SQUAD] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
